title: Gel Electrophoresis - TBE 0.5X
author: Simona Abbà
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.s38egrw

steps.title: Prepare agarose solution
steps.instruction: Combine 150 mL of 0.5X TBE buffer with 1.5 g agarose in a 250 mL Duran bottle, melt in a microwave on medium power for 2 min (or until clear) while stirring occasionally, then remove with a glove and cool under tap water until safe to handle (≈2 min).

substeps.instruction: Pour 150 mL 0.5X TBE buffer into a 250 mL Duran bottle.
Weigh 1.5 g agarose and add to the bottle.
Microwave on medium power for 2 min or until the solution is clear, stirring occasionally.
Remove bottle with a glove/pot holder and cool under tap water until it can be comfortably handled (≈2 min).

steps.title: Cast agarose gel
steps.instruction: Set up the casting tray, add combs, level the tray, then pour either 40 mL (small gel) or 70 mL (large gel) of the molten agarose and allow it to solidify for 15 min or until firm.

substeps.instruction: Place the gel tray on a clamp and add well combs; use a level to ensure the tray is balanced.
Pour 40 mL (small gel) or 70 mL (big gel) of melted agarose into the tray.
Let the gel sit for 15 min or until it is solid.

steps.title: Remove combs and tray
steps.instruction: Carefully lift the well comb(s) without tearing the gel, then remove the tray from the clamp while keeping the gel in the tray.

steps.title: Load gel and samples
steps.instruction: Place the gel tray into the electrophoresis chamber with wells toward the negative (black) side, fill the chamber with additional 0.5X TBE buffer to cover the gel, pipette 5 µL of the 1 kb DNA Ladder (Invitrogen Catalog #10787018) with loading dye into a well, and load DNA samples mixed with 6X Gel Loading Dye (Thermo Fisher Catalog #R0611).

substeps.instruction: Insert the gel tray into the apparatus, wells nearest the negative electrode.
Add 0.5X TBE buffer to both sides of the chamber until the gel is covered with a thin buffer layer.
Pipette 5 µL of 1 kb DNA Ladder (Invitrogen Catalog #10787018) with loading dye into a well.
Prepare DNA samples by adding an appropriate amount of 6X Gel Loading Dye (Thermo Fisher Catalog #R0611) and load them into the remaining wells.

steps.title: Run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Close the lid, connect the power supply, set a constant voltage of 90 V for a small gel or 120 V for a large gel, and run until the bromophenol blue front reaches the end of the gel.

substeps.instruction: Place the lid on the apparatus and plug the power cables into the power supply.
Set the voltage to 90 V (small gel) or 120 V (big gel).
Run the gel until the bromophenol blue dye reaches the far end of the gel.

steps.title: Stain gel with ethidium bromide
steps.instruction: After electrophoresis, drain excess TBE buffer, transfer the gel to a tray containing 1 % ethidium bromide (avoid skin contact), place the tray on a shaker with gentle agitation, and stain for 15 min.

substeps.instruction: Remove the gel from the tray and drain excess TBE buffer.
Place the gel into a tray with 1 % ethidium bromide, taking care that the solution does not contact skin.
Put the tray on a shaker and agitate gently for 15 min.

steps.title: Destain gel
steps.instruction: Transfer the stained gel to a tray of distilled water, place on a shaker with gentle agitation, and destain for 10 min.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove the gel from the ethidium bromide solution.
Place the gel into a tray containing distilled water.
Shake gently for 10 min to destain.

steps.title: Image gel under UV
steps.instruction: Position the gel on a UV transilluminator, turn on the UV light, and capture an image with a camera.

substeps.instruction: Place the gel on top of a UV light source.
Turn on the UV illumination.
Photograph the gel with a camera.
